title: Scrum Master
description:

title: Scrum Master / Delivery Coach
description:
**Company Description**
**Who We Are**
 Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.
   

  

 We are feeding the world’s curiosity!
   

  

**Job Description**
 Delivery Coach / Scrum Master — Salesforce (Primary) \& NetSuite (Secondary)
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Delivery Coach / Scrum Master to lead delivery, primarily for our Salesforce team (approximately 90% of the role), with the remaining 10% supporting the NetSuite team. In this role you will act as a servant\-leader, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, coaching the team on Agile (and other) principles, and creating the conditions for high, sustainable delivery. You will remove impediments, protect the team's focus, and foster a culture of transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines strong facilitation and coaching skills with familiarity with the Salesforce delivery landscape.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the primary Scrum Master for the Salesforce team (\~90% of the role), facilitating all core Scrum ceremonies.
* Provide Scrum Master support to the NetSuite team as needed (\~10% of the role), coordinating across both workstreams.
* Coach both teams on Agile and Scrum practices, driving continuous improvement.
* Facilitate retrospectives that surface honest insights and produce concrete, tracked improvement actions.
* Identify, track, and remove impediments that block progress across the Salesforce and NetSuite teams.
* Protect the teams from external disruption and help maintain a sustainable pace.
* Partner with product owners to keep backlogs healthy, refined, and well\-prioritised.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies, especially where Salesforce and NetSuite integrate.
* Maintain transparent reporting on sprint health, delivery metrics, and progress for stakeholders.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Solid, demonstrable understanding of Agile principles and the Scrum framework.
* Proven experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and coaching delivery teams.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Effective stakeholder management across technical and business audiences.
* Ability to remove impediments and promote team self\-organisation.
* Proficiency with an Agile work\-tracking tool and delivery reporting.


**Preferred Experience**
* 3–5 years in a Scrum Master role.
* Experience supporting Salesforce delivery teams or projects.
* Exposure to NetSuite projects or ERP delivery.
* Relevant Agile or Scrum certification (e.g., CSM, PSM).


 Tools \& Systems
   

  

* Salesforce — primary supported platform (\~90%).
* NetSuite — secondary supported platform (\~10%).
* Agile work\-tracking tool — for backlog, sprint boards, and reporting. Jira
* Collaboration tools — Confluence, Slack, Jira


 Accountability Measures
   

  

* Ceremony effectiveness: well\-facilitated, outcome\-focused Scrum events across both teams.
* Impediment resolution: blockers identified and resolved in a timely manner.
* Delivery predictability: consistent achievement of sprint commitments and stable flow.
* Cross\-platform coordination: Salesforce/NetSuite dependencies managed smoothly.
* Transparency: clear, current reporting on progress and delivery metrics.


**Qualifications**
 Agile / Scrum Master (required)
   

  

 Jira (preferred)
   

  

 SAFe (optional)
   

  

 Prince2/Project Managent (optional)
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Our Values**
**Collaboration is our superpower**
* We uncover rich perspectives across the world
* Success happens together
* We deliver across borders.


**Innovation is in our blood**
* We’re pioneers in our industry
* Our curiosity is insatiable
* We bring the best ideas to life.


**We Do What We Say**
* We’re accountable for our work and actions
* Excellence comes as standard
* We’re open, honest and kind, always.


**We are caring**
* We learn from each other’s experiences
* Stop and listen; every opinion matters
* We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


**More About Cint**
 We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.
   

  

 In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin\-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US\-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first\-party survey data in over 110 countries.
   

  

 Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)
   

  

 Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

title: Global IT Configuration Engineer Senior Specialist
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 In a world where data is critical to BCG's success, we are building first\-class, foundational capabilities and products across the firm. Within this vision, LEAP is delivering BCG's new Learning platform to power the firm's learning and development needs.
   

  

 Initially, you’ll work within the Data Product squad to build a custom data product in Snowflake as part of a broader transformation program of BCG’s learning technology. The data product will help enable AI\-driven learning and make learning data accessible to other teams and systems, including, for example, staffing and analytics. When the program has ended, you’ll be part of a Learning squad with RtB as its scope.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**
* Develop well\-structured Agile user stories and acceptance criteria that enable effective solution delivery, and owning your area of backlog
* Analyze processes and data needs, contributing to solution design and identifying practical approaches to business problems.
* Coordinate functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
* Support release readiness and implementation, identifying issues and working with technical teams to resolve them.
* Elicit, document, and validate requirements by engaging multiple stakeholder groups and subject matter experts.
* Write clear, well\-structured user stories and acceptance criteria understandable by both technical and functional colleagues.
* Create, update, and maintain requirements documentation (e.g., PRDs / functional specifications).
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, anticipating questions and translating technical details into plain language.
* Manage and triage support requests in a query management system (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Proactively flag risks and dependencies, keeping learner impact and business value as the priority.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

***Education***
* Bachelor's degree required.
* 5–8 years of experience as a business / systems analyst, ideally supporting or configuring enterprise applications.


**Experience / Knowledge**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5\-7 years of experience with Learning or HR applications.
* Experience with learning management or experience platforms; Docebo experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with data products, third\-party platforms, and SaaS technology solutions.
* Working technical fluency with Snowflake, querying databases, and querying APIs to understand and validate data.
* Strong Agile experience, including writing user stories and working with Jira, sprints, and ceremonies.
* Experience developing and executing functional, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience using AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 The Business Analyst is a role within the Data Product Squad, part of LEAP in BCG's digital products organisation. Reporting to the IT Director, you will work day\-to\-day with your Product Owner, Chapter Leads, Scrum Master, and squad members, as well as functional business partners, subject matter experts, and IT colleagues. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the business to analyse, configure, and evolve BCG's new Learning platform, supporting both day\-to\-day operations and transformative change.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**You're Good At**
* Translating learning and business needs into product requirements — asking the right questions and pushing past surface\-level answers.
* Writing clear, well\-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements documentation.
* Communicating clearly, both verbally and in writing, with all staff levels including leadership; excellent listening skills.
* Engaging and managing stakeholders across business, functional, and IT groups, and collaborating remotely with global experts.
* Being outcome\-focused — keeping learner impact and business value front of mind.
* Owning your workstream — taking responsibility for your area of the backlog and delivery, proactively flagging risks.
* Managing data definitions and basic governance — flagging when a decision has governance implications.
* Working within an Agile framework.


*"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*
